en.headline: Wear’s HK designer pop-ups close tonight after a two-week run
en.dek: Four of the Clothing Industry Training Authority pop-ups for Hong Kong Fashion Fest remain open on 14 September at ifc mall, Harbour City, Pacific Place and the airport.
body: Wear’s HK, a city-wide pop-up programme of the third Hong Kong Fashion Fest, ends on Monday 14 September. The Clothing Industry Training Authority organised the stalls with sponsorship from the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency under the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau, placing work by 20 Hong Kong designer brands in six retail sites from 1 September.

According to the organisers’ published timetable, four locations still operate on the final day: ifc mall podium level 1, Harbour City Gateway Arcade Atrium II, Harvey Nichols on level 2 of Pacific Place, and shop 6T508C on level 6 of the Terminal 1 departures hall at Hong Kong International Airport, the last of these inside the restricted area. Those four sites are listed as open from 11am to 8pm, except the airport shop, which is listed from 7am to 11pm. The Hysan Place and Festival Walk stalls were scheduled to finish on 13 September.

A related display of garments by the same designers runs until 14 September on the first floor of Jardine House in Central as part of Fashion Summit (HK) 2026. The Fest’s official pages list the programme dates but do not publish ticket prices for the mall pop-ups, which have been presented as walk-in retail counters rather than ticketed shows.

zh.headline: 「Wear’s HK」本地時裝快閃店今日結束
zh.dek: 第三屆香港時裝薇快閃店項目周一踏入最後一天，國際金融中心商場、海港城、太古廣場及機場四個點仍按公布時間開放。
body: 由製衣業訓練局主辦、文化體育及旅遊局轄下文創產業發展處贊助的「Wear’s HK」快閃店，屬第三屆香港時裝薇節目，將於9月14日結束。項目自9月1日起在全港六個零售點展出20個香港時裝品牌的作品。
主辦單位公布的時間表顯示，最後一天仍開放的地點包括國際金融中心商場一樓平台、海港城港威商場大堂II、太古廣場二樓Harvey Nichols，以及香港國際機場一號客運大樓六樓離港層禁區6T508C號舖。前三處公布開放時間為上午11時至晚上8時，機場店則為上午7時至晚上11時。希慎廣場及又一城的快閃店已定於9月13日結束。
同一批設計師的服裝亦在中環怡和大廈一樓「時尚高峰（香港）2026」展覽展出至9月14日。時裝薇官方網頁列明活動日期，但沒有為商場快閃店公布門票價錢，有關攤位以即場零售形式運作。
